models_evaluated: conversational AI decision aid for antidepressant selection in major depressive disorder

links.outcome: AI decision aid concept retrieval and recommendation accuracy across simulated health literacy levels
links.effect: Rank-1 concept retrieval increased from 47.6% for limited health literacy to 81.9% for proficient health literacy, with corresponding declines in antidepressant recommendation accuracy.
links.quote: Rank-1 concept retrieval increased from 47.6% for limited health literacy to 81.9% for proficient health literacy, with corresponding declines in antidepressant recommendation accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM-based patient simulation aligned with NIST AI RMF Map and Measure functions to assess risk across medical, linguistic, and behavioral patient profiles

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and evaluating a multi-turn patient simulation framework aligned with NIST AI RMF to test and uncover equity and performance risks (e.g. across health literacy levels) in a conversational clinical AI decision aid before deployment.
